## Changes made from the upstream version

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-06:

- Rewrote in SkillOffice format as a numbered process; body about 80 lines.
- Kept the four modes (problem exploration, solution ideation, assumption testing, strategy exploration), the session rhythm and the thinking-partner stance.
- Condensed the framework descriptions (How Might We, Jobs to be Done, opportunity solution trees, first principles, SCAMPER, OODA, reverse brainstorming) and anti-patterns into `references/frameworks.md` tables.
- Company and market context now comes from the SkillOffice context profile.
- Added an explicit rule never to invent research, quotes or metrics, a structured session summary, a quality checklist, a safety note and a handoff section.
